certificate_theory_binding: fixed-axiom and schema presets are external to the word; descriptor bit 0 means the selected fixed axiom
node_metric: expanded primitive bot/mem/imp/and/or/all/ex tree nodes; iff is expanded as two implications and a conjunction; variable payloads excluded; this is neither bit length nor TM state count
recursion_policy: deep finite syntax may raise RecursionError; recursion limits are not caught as invalid proofs
scope: recursive finite diagnostics/reference of an ideal PR syntax procedure; not an executable total infinite search; no binary-machine or consistency proof
